notes.title: DEBUG & REVISION
notes.content:
- ceiling slopes do not react like a wall anymore,
and should be easier to catch with ceiling slide mechanics.

- level 6-6 revision : now less precision required to beat it.
- level 2-7 revision too : some spikes and springs change to be better.
- level 5-7 revision : some traffic sign added.

notes.title: Reset input commands to default with 'Escape' hotkey !
notes.content:
You can reset input commands to default with 'Escape' hotkey if you're stuck with wrong commands setup, in both title and input menu.
You'll see a caption warning you about this.

notes.title: 1.7 is out !!
notes.content:
scroll down levels : 
camera go slower when close to screen top, so especially level 6-6 will be a bit easier,
camera was a bit fast there!


level 6-9 : small change to avoid a instant-fall-in-lava on certain devices.
on some devices (maybe because of high FPS frequency screen) you would fall immediately in lava after the tobbogan at some point) now might be fixed up.

thank you everyone for your comments and feedbacks !!
